description: List the AI agents and tools added to the ZeroCrew directory in the last days, newest first: the same list as the ZeroCrew weekly email. Use it for a weekly check of what is new, then pick the ones that fit the person's business. Covers the last 7 days by default, up to 30. Narrow it with role. When nothing was added in that time, it says so and returns the latest additions with their dates. Call get_tool for one tool's full page.

days.description: How many days back to look, 1 to 30. Default 7.

limit.description: How many tools to return, 1 to 20. Default 20.

role.description: Only tools for this business role. list_roles shows every role.

name: whats_new
title: New tools on ZeroCrew
